item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance Devs Are Somehow Surprised That Fans Still Like Turn-Based Combat

description.p: "I expected opinions on it might be divided".Final Fantasy Resonance was met with high praise when it launched on 22nd October 2026, earning a score of 8/10 from us and a critic average of 85 over on Metacritic.Despite being an adaptation of a somewhat middling mobile title, Resonance's focus on turn-based combat mixed with the handsome HD-2D visuals made it an instant fan-favourite.
